title: EP01 — 선택 · 후폭풍 · 기억
intent: Close Episode 01 by turning record pressure, evening reflection and the next morning into memory of the player's actual route rather than a generic epilogue.
design_rules: Record choices trade speed, document alignment and evidentiary completeness; none is written as falsification or an obvious bad answer.
The evening screen recalls the branch the player actually took at 07:18 and the deepest consequence that branch produced.
Rest, family time, study and field notes are all legitimate recovery/learning choices with different value.
The next morning begins from yesterday's trace and offers present-state inspection, photo comparison or worker reporting routes when unlocked.
The episode ends with a forward hook: yesterday's decision becomes today's starting condition.
